title: Little is known of the quiddities beyond their roles

statements.text: Little is known about quiddities beyond the theoretical roles they play, and there is no widely accepted conception of physical quiddities. Pereboom holds that this ignorance may be remediable, and Chalmers that a positive conception might be reached by theoretical inference from the character of phenomenal properties.

sources.quote: we know little about quiddities beyond the theoretical roles they are supposed to play
The conclusion to this argument is not inevitable and permanent ignorance, but rather a sort that is potentially remediable.
Perhaps we can do this indirectly, by some sort of theoretical inference from the character of phenomenal properties to their underlying constituents
